simple.prompt: Formal opening salutation when recipient's name is unknown: '___,'
simple.explanation: Dalam korespondensi bisnis resmi tradisional bahasa Inggris, jika nama penerima tidak diketahui, gunakan 'Dear Sir or Madam,' (diakhiri 'Yours faithfully,').
hints: Salam pembuka resmi tradisional jika nama tidak diketahui.

simple.prompt: Stating the purpose of writing: 'I am writing to ___ clarification regarding the proposed restructuring.'
simple.explanation: Gunakan 'request' sebagai padanan resmi dalam pembuka surat bisnis: 'I am writing to request clarification...'.

simple.targetSentence: Please find attached the finalized quarterly expenditure report.
simple.explanation: Please find attached + the finalized quarterly expenditure report.
hints: Objek lampiran: 'the finalized quarterly expenditure report'.

simple.prompt: Formal closing sign-off when addressing someone by name ('Dear Ms. Jenkins,'): '___,'
simple.explanation: Aturan korespondensi baku British/Commonwealth: Jika menyapa dengan nama ('Dear Ms. Jenkins'), penutupnya adalah 'Yours sincerely,'. Jika tanpa nama ('Dear Sir/Madam'), penutupnya adalah 'Yours faithfully,'.
hints: Pasangan salam pembuka bernama (Dear Ms. Jenkins).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat formal permohonan tindak lanjut.
simple.targetSentence: I would appreciate your prompt response regarding this matter.
simple.explanation: I would appreciate + your prompt response regarding this matter.
hints: Permohonan sopan: 'your prompt response regarding this matter'.

simple.explanation: Judul standar dokumen laporan manajerial resmi adalah 'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY'.

simple.targetSentence: This report examines the feasibility of expanding our operations.
simple.explanation: This report examines + the feasibility of expanding our operations.
hints: Tujuan laporan: 'the feasibility of expanding our operations'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog penyampaian kabar buruk dalam korespondensi resmi.
dialogue: How should we inform the applicant that their grant was rejected?
We should write: 'We ___ to inform you that we are unable to approve your application at this time.'
intermediate.explanation: 'We regret to inform you that...' adalah formula diplomatis baku dan bermartabat untuk menyampaikan keputusan negatif dalam korespondensi resmi.

intermediate.prompt: Executive report recommendations section formula: 'It is strongly ___ that management commission an independent audit.'
intermediate.explanation: Pola pasif rekomendasi laporan formal: 'It is strongly recommended that [subject] + subjunctive base verb...'.

intermediate.prompt: Offering assistance diplomatically: 'Should you require any further assistance, please do not ___ to contact me.'
intermediate.explanation: Formula penutup bantuan resmi: 'please do not hesitate to contact me'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penyampaian apresiasi atas kerja sama.
intermediate.targetSentence: Thank you for your continued cooperation and support.
intermediate.explanation: Thank you for your continued cooperation and support.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Thank you for your continued'.

intermediate.prompt: Report methodology section heading: 'DATA ___ AND METHODOLOGY'
intermediate.explanation: 'DATA COLLECTION AND METHODOLOGY' adalah tajuk standar laporan ilmiah dan konsultasi manajemen.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pembuka penyesalan penundaan pengiriman.
intermediate.targetSentence: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by this delay.
intermediate.explanation: We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by this delay.
hints: Mulai dengan permohonan maaf resmi: 'We sincerely apologize for'.
Dampak: 'any inconvenience caused by this delay'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog tindak lanjut pertemuan bisnis.
dialogue: Will you send a summary of our discussion?
Yes, I will transmit the agreed action items ___ of tomorrow's meeting.
intermediate.explanation: 'The minutes of the meeting' (notula rapat) adalah istilah resmi dokumen catatan keputusan pertemuan bisnis.

complex.prompt: Koreksi inkonsistensi nada bicara (tone) yang terlalu agresif dalam surat tuntutan kepatuhan.
complex.draft: You guys must pay the invoice immediately or we will drag you to court right now.
options: We respectfully request the immediate settlement of the outstanding invoice, failing which we shall be obliged to instruct our legal counsel to commence recovery proceedings.
Pay the money now because we really need it.
Please send the cash quick so we don't sue you.
complex.explanation: Surat tuntutan hukum resmi mempertahankan kesopanan dingin yang tak tergoyahkan (unflinching polite restraint): 'We respectfully request the immediate settlement..., failing which we shall be obliged to instruct our legal counsel...'.
hints: Gunakan bahasa hukum yang tenang, tegas, dan berwibawa.

complex.prompt: Structure of a formal investigative report: What is the normative order of sections?
options: Executive Summary -> Introduction -> Methodology -> Findings -> Discussion -> Recommendations
Recommendations -> Jokes -> Table of Contents -> Conclusion
complex.explanation: Urutan kanonikal laporan formal: Ringkasan Eksekutif $\rightarrow$ Pendahuluan $\rightarrow$ Metodologi $\rightarrow$ Temuan $\rightarrow$ Pembahasan $\rightarrow$ Rekomendasi.
hints: Pilih opsi Executive Summary -> Introduction -> Methodology...

complex.prompt: Email etiquette in crisis communications: When communicating a data breach to enterprise clients, the opening paragraph should:
options: immediately disclose the nature and containment of the incident without deflection or evasive euphemisms
blame third-party vendors and downplay the severity
start with a promotional pitch about new product upgrades
complex.explanation: Komunikasi krisis profesional menuntut transparansi cepat, fakta konkret mengenai penahanan insiden (containment), dan empati tanpa penghindaran tanggung jawab.
hints: Transparansi langsung dan penanganan insiden yang jelas.
Pilih opsi immediately disclose the nature and containment.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat resolusi rekomendasi laporan audit.
complex.targetSentence: Management should allocate capital to strengthen internal cybersecurity infrastructure.
complex.explanation: Management should allocate capital + to strengthen internal cybersecurity infrastructure.

complex.prompt: Koreksi penutup email yang terlalu santai untuk komunikasi ke dewan komisaris.
options: Respectfully submitted, Johnathan Vance, Senior Vice President.
complex.explanation: Untuk dokumen formal kepada dewan komisaris, penutup harus mencerminkan rasa hormat dan jabatan resmi: 'Respectfully submitted, Johnathan Vance, Senior Vice President'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence formulating a diplomatic conditional escalation in commercial correspondence:
options: In the absence of a response by Friday close of business, we shall have no alternative but to reassign the territory.
If you don't reply by Friday we take the area back.
Reply until Friday or else you lose it.
complex.explanation: 'In the absence of a response by [date/time], we shall have no alternative but to...' adalah formula eskalasi diplomatis standar korporasi multinasional.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog penyusunan laporan kelayakan ekonomi.
dialogue: How should we frame the cost-benefit analysis in the report conclusion?
State that the projected return on investment outweighs the capital expenditure by a ratio of ___.
options: three to one over the designated five-year horizon
complex.explanation: Presisi numerik dan jangka waktu ('three to one over the designated five-year horizon') mencerminkan standar laporan konsultasi manajemen papan atas.
hints: Presisi rasio finansial terukur dengan horison waktu.
Pilih 'three to one over the designated five-year horizon'.
